# Search and export

**Status:** draft

Search must load its searchable rows from the CSV snapshot produced by export_matches.
Export_matches must call search_items to select rows before creating that snapshot.
Neither snapshot creation nor search may use a separate source of rows. Both tickets depend
on the other. No startup order or cycle resolution has been accepted.

CSV uses name,quantity headings and LF endings. Empty matches produce a header-only CSV.
